Name: Harem Valley
Author: Feldspar110
Description:
[color=#e69138][size=4][b]---IMPORTANT ITEMS/COMPATABILITIES---[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]This mod is not compatable with the original 'Valley Girls' mod. Having both installed will break things. HV includes all VG content, so you won't be missing out on anything. Additionally, any mod that uses VG as a base (like Unfaithful Wives) will also break things.
[/list][list]
[*]This mod is compatable with SVE, but the event maps won't have continuity with the game maps. 
[/list][list]
[*]This mod is for Male Farmers only. The original Valley Girls works with Female farmers, but the expansion does not add female content. Due to the way events are triggered, they can't check for farmer gender. 
[/list][list]
[*]This mod is *technically* compatable with Xtardew, but as that mod replaces 8 and 10 heart events, the pacing will be all wrong (Characters will note that its their first time, even though you've been... seeing them for months now)﻿. I created Harem Valley due to Xtardew not having enough casual encounters, so the two don't really work together.
[/list][list]
[*]Due to this being a relationship focused mod, the default friendship gain can sometime feel a bit too fast. I recommend pairing this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17055]Friendship Tweaks[/url], and setting both the Increase and Decrease multiplier to 0.6-0.8, to make relationships develop at a more natural pace. 
[/list]

Thank you to TrashRacc for the amazing base mod, I would definitly not have been able to build this all without the inital framework. If I end up making any money off of this, half will be sent to them for their contribution.

[*][size=3]20+ unique, repeatable sexual encounters, which are triggered at random when talking to NPC's while they are pleasuring, and evolve as you build friendship with them (2-4 per NPC)[/size]

[/list][list]
[*][size=3]2 farmer driven events events (will probably add more in the future)[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]4 Poly events (will also probably add more)[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]You can have Abigail wear thigh-high tights[/size] 
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]New animated portraits for events[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]

I hope you enjoy the mod! If you do, and you'd like to toss me a dollar or two, it would be greatly appreciated, though in no way required :)[/size][size=3]
